name: cavemio-streaming-answer
title: Streaming answer
description: An answer as it arrives, with inline citations, actions, sources and follow-ups.

cavemio.usage:
import { StreamingText, AnswerActions, FollowUps } from "@/components/streaming-answer";

<StreamingText
  content={["Signups are up 23%.", { type: "citation", label: "Q3 report" }, " Churn is down."]}
  status="streaming"
/>
<AnswerActions className="mt-4" copyText={text} onRegenerate={retry} sources={sources} />
<FollowUps className="mt-4" items={["Which channels bring the most signups"]} onSelect={ask} />

// Markdown: pass your renderer as children instead of content
<StreamingText status={status}>
  <ReactMarkdown>{text}</ReactMarkdown>
</StreamingText>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Words keep a stable key, so only new words mount and fade in; the answer is ordinary text for copying and screen readers.
- Finished paragraphs are memoised, so long answers stay smooth while streaming.
- Every icon button has a label and the feedback buttons use aria-pressed; "Copied" is announced from a status region beside them.
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion, words and citations appear without fading, the caret stops blinking and the actions change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: StreamingText content
props.description: – · The answer so far. Blank lines start new paragraphs.

props.name: StreamingText status
props.description: "done" · Caret while streaming; notes for stopped and error.

props.name: StreamingText onRetry / children
props.description: – · Retry button on error; your own renderer (e.g. Markdown) instead of content.

props.name: AnswerActions copyText / onRegenerate
props.description: – · Copy button (omit to hide) and regenerate button.

props.name: AnswerActions feedback / defaultFeedback / onFeedback
props.description: – · Thumbs up or down; controlled so you can restore it from your database.

props.name: AnswerActions sources / onSourcesClick / disabled
props.description: – · Source favicons or dots with a count; disable while streaming.

useCases.title: AI chat apps

useCases.title: Search and research tools
useCases.description: Answers with citations that point at their sources.

useCases.title: Support bots

useCases.title: Documentation assistants
useCases.description: Answers with the sources they were taken from.

features.title: Only new words fade in
features.description: Words keep a stable key, so only the newly arrived ones mount and fade in, with a caret at the end.

features.title: Long answers stay smooth
features.description: Finished paragraphs are memoised and don’t re-render while the last one grows.

features.title: Citations inside sentences
features.description: Citations land as small chips in the sentence, ready to link to a source.

features.title: Actions that answer back
features.description: Copy blurs into a drawn check, a thumb fills with a small pop, and the sources count rolls as more arrive.

features.title: Stopped and interrupted answers
features.description: A quiet “Stopped” note, or “The answer was interrupted” with a Retry button.

features.title: Your own Markdown renderer
features.description: Pass children instead of content to use any renderer, and add suggested follow-up questions underneath.

states.title: streaming
states.description: Caret at the end; new words fade in; the paragraph is aria-busy.

states.title: done
states.description: Plain, selectable text; actions enabled. Copy shrinks away through a blur as a green check draws itself (380ms); a chosen thumb fills (220ms) with a 420ms thrown pop.

states.title: stopped
states.description: A quiet "Stopped" note when the user stopped generation.

states.title: error
states.description: "The answer was interrupted." with a Retry button.
